title: RLVR-World: Training World Models with Reinforcement Learning
paper_type_zh: 多模态世界模型的 RLVR 训练配方、反馈契约与数据披露审计
best_for_zh: 关注可验证奖励、世界模型、智能体环境轨迹、数据血缘和后训练审计的研究者与工程人员
one_line: Releases code, two derived language-transition datasets and RLVR checkpoints for world models whose programmatic rewards are exact state/item agreement or frame-level L1 plus LPIPS, while upstream lineage and audit artifacts remain partial.
RLVR-World 发布了代码、两个派生语言状态转移数据集和 RLVR 检查点；其文本、网页与视频世界模型分别采用精确状态/条目一致性或 L1 加 LPIPS 反馈，但上游数据血缘、权利、切分和审计工件仍不完整。
why: It exposes feedback contracts and operational details that are usually obscured in RLVR reports, and it shows why a released model/data collection still needs separate provenance, split and verifier-validity auditing before reuse.
inclusion_reason: A NeurIPS 2025 RLVR recipe and author-linked release that makes distinct rule-based feedback contracts inspectable across text-game, web-state and video/robot world modeling, while retaining material lineage, split, rights and semantic-validity limits.

title: Problem
问题
html:
World-model post-training needs transition data and feedback that reflect what changes after an action. In language, web, robot, and simulated settings, a plausible-looking prediction is not enough: the training signal must identify whether a state difference, accessibility-tree change, or future frame agrees with ground truth. At the same time, a paper-level description of upstream trajectories does not by itself establish their provenance, rights, train/evaluation separation, or deployment validity.

RLVR-World addresses the modeling side by applying supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to world-transition prediction across these modalities. Its audit-relevant question is separate: which data and checkpoints are actually released, and which source, verifier, and environment facts remain only paper-reported or unknown.

世界模型后训练需要能够反映动作之后发生何种变化的状态转移数据和反馈。在语言、网页、机器人和模拟环境中，看起来合理的预测并不充分：训练信号必须识别状态差异、可访问性树变化或未来帧是否与真值一致。与此同时，对上游轨迹的论文级描述本身并不能证明其血缘、权利、训练/评测隔离或部署有效性。

RLVR-World 在建模层面以监督微调和可验证奖励强化学习处理这些跨模态状态转移预测；其审计层面的独立问题是：哪些数据和检查点确已发布，哪些来源、验证器与环境事实仍仅见于论文披露或仍属未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
RLVR-World treats world modeling as predicting an action-conditioned transition rather than only generating fluent text. For text games, the model predicts state differences under natural-language rules and actions; for WebArena, it predicts exact changed accessibility-tree items; for video, it predicts one or more future frames from visual observations and quantized actions. It then applies task-specific rule or metric feedback to on-policy candidates.

The central feedback contracts are deliberately different: complete-match or property-aware text-game reward, exact-item F1 for WebArena changes, and negative L1 plus LPIPS for decoded video frames. This makes the release valuable as a comparison of verifier designs, while not making any one reward a universal measure of semantic correctness or safe downstream control.

RLVR-World 将世界建模视为预测由动作条件化的状态转移，而不只是生成流畅文本。对于文字游戏，模型在自然语言规则和动作条件下预测状态差异；对于 WebArena，模型预测精确变化的可访问性树条目；对于视频，模型从视觉观测和量化动作预测一个或多个未来帧。随后，它对在线采样的候选使用任务特定的规则或度量反馈。

核心反馈契约彼此不同：文字游戏采用完全匹配或属性感知奖励，WebArena 变化采用精确条目 F1，解码视频帧采用负 L1 加 LPIPS。这使该发布可用于比较验证器设计，但并不意味着其中任何一种奖励都是语义正确性或安全下游控制的通用度量。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper reports four upstream families. ByteSized32 supplies 76,369 text-game transitions from 31 games; its 2,954-transition high-quality subset is described as the official test subset. Text SFT uses 4,237 correct DeepSeek-R1 responses retained by rejection sampling, with unchanged transitions downsampled to changed:unchanged ratios of 100:40 for binary reward and 100:5 for task-specific reward. Language GRPO uses group size 5, temperature 1.0, and top-p 1.0.

For WebArena, the paper starts from about 14,000 WMA trajectories, removes prompt-plus-target pairs longer than 5,000 tokens, retains about 7,000, and reports a 99%/1% split. The SFT target combines GPT-4o-mini CoT released by WMA with extracted accessibility-tree changes. For video, it uses RT-1/Open X-Embodiment plus PushT, Rope, and Granular inputs named from DINO-WM; the paper reports 87,212 RT-1 trajectories and a 99%/1% split. Separate 138M autoregressive video transformers use frozen VQGAN/FSQ tokenizers; main video analysis reports GRPO group size 16.

The author-linked collection visibly releases derived text-game and WebArena CoT datasets, code, and model/tokenizer checkpoints. It does not, from the accepted evidence, provide one immutable manifest joining all upstream inputs, selected/rejected records, rollout traces, reward decisions, source rights, and final-checkpoint lineage.

论文报告了四类上游来源。ByteSized32 提供来自 31 个文字游戏的 76,369 条状态转移；其中 2,954 条高质量子集被描述为官方测试子集。文字 SFT 使用经拒绝采样保留的 4,237 个正确 DeepSeek-R1 响应；未变化转移按变化:未变化为 100:40（二元奖励）或 100:5（任务特定奖励）下采样。语言 GRPO 的组大小为 5、温度为 1.0、top-p 为 1.0。

对于 WebArena，论文从约 14,000 条 WMA 轨迹开始，移除提示词加目标超过 5,000 token 的样本，保留约 7,000 条，并报告 99%/1% 切分。SFT 目标把 WMA 发布的 GPT-4o-mini CoT 与提取出的可访问性树变化拼接。对于视频，论文使用 RT-1/Open X-Embodiment，以及来自 DINO-WM 的 PushT、Rope 和 Granular 输入；论文报告 87,212 条 RT-1 轨迹和 99%/1% 切分。独立的 138M 自回归视频 Transformer 使用冻结的 VQGAN/FSQ tokenizer；主要视频分析报告 GRPO 组大小为 16。

作者关联的集合明确发布了派生的文字游戏和 WebArena CoT 数据集、代码以及模型/tokenizer 检查点。根据已接受证据，该集合并未提供一份不可变清单，将全部上游输入、选中/拒绝记录、rollout 轨迹、奖励决策、来源权利与最终检查点血缘连接起来。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The verified NeurIPS record, arXiv paper, THUML repository/project, and author-linked Hugging Face collection support the existence of the paper, code, project page, two derived language-transition datasets, and multiple model/tokenizer checkpoints. The collection is evidence of released derived artifacts, not evidence that every paper-reported upstream trajectory or online RLVR rollout is publicly available.

The paper documents distinct supervised objects and reward definitions across text games, web-state prediction, and video/robot prediction. It also reports WebArena evaluation on Docker-configured AWS EC2 across Shopping, CMS, Reddit, GitLab, and Mapping, and describes Web MPC that samples 20 actions, keeps the three most frequent, and repeats value scoring 20 times. These are reported experimental procedures, not deployment validation, an independently released environment image, or proof that a world-model prediction is safe for control.

The paper reports named split ratios and counts, but accepted evidence did not establish immutable split files, source-level record IDs, rejected-rollout logs, complete environment dependencies, or end-to-end run logs. The Card therefore treats artifact availability as verified while keeping provenance completeness partial.

已核验的 NeurIPS 记录、arXiv 论文、THUML 仓库/项目页和作者关联的 Hugging Face 集合支持以下事实：论文、代码、项目页、两个派生语言状态转移数据集以及多个模型/tokenizer 检查点确实存在。该集合证明派生工件已发布，但并不证明论文报告的每一条上游轨迹或在线 RLVR rollout 都已公开。

论文记录了文字游戏、网页状态预测和视频/机器人预测中不同的监督对象与奖励定义；还报告了在 Docker 配置的 AWS EC2 上、覆盖 Shopping、CMS、Reddit、GitLab 和 Mapping 的 WebArena 评测，并描述 Web MPC 会采样 20 个动作、保留最常出现的 3 个、再重复 20 次价值评分。这些是论文报告的实验流程，不是部署验证、独立发布的环境镜像，也不证明世界模型预测可安全用于控制。

论文报告了具名的切分比例和数量，但已接受证据未能建立不可变切分文件、来源级记录 ID、被拒绝 rollout 日志、完整环境依赖或端到端运行日志。因此，本 Card 将工件可得性视为已核验，同时将血缘完整性保留为部分披露。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not a single common training corpus or a frontier-model report. Its distinctive value is one autoregressive world-model recipe spanning language state transitions and visual future prediction while exposing three materially different feedback contracts. The same release surface therefore lets a reader compare exact symbolic agreement, changed-item F1, and perceptual frame metrics without treating them as interchangeable.

It also makes a useful disclosure distinction: the author collection releases derived language data and checkpoints, whereas ByteSized32, WMA/WebArena, RT-1/Open X-Embodiment, and DINO-WM are named upstream inputs with incomplete unified lineage. That boundary is more informative for reuse than a paper-title-only record.

该工作的贡献不是一个统一的训练语料库，也不是前沿模型报告。其独特价值在于：以同一套自回归世界模型配方覆盖语言状态转移和视觉未来预测，同时披露三种在实质上不同的反馈契约。因此，读者可以在同一发布面上比较精确符号一致性、变化条目 F1 与感知帧度量，而不把它们视为可互换的信号。

它还明确了一个有用的披露边界：作者集合发布的是派生语言数据和检查点；ByteSized32、WMA/WebArena、RT-1/Open X-Embodiment 和 DINO-WM 则是具名上游输入，其统一血缘仍不完整。对再利用而言，这一边界比只记录论文标题更有信息量。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Exact complete-match and exact-item F1 rewards can penalize semantically equivalent outputs and may reward formatting or tokenization alignment. Negative L1 plus LPIPS measures frame similarity, not physical correctness, causal fidelity, or safety for policy deployment. None of these feedback signals substitutes for downstream task validation.

The text-game description does not make the use of the 2,954-transition official test subset sufficiently stage-specific for a train/evaluation-overlap audit. The WebArena procedure selects the checkpoint with highest test reward, so an independent final selection surface is not documented. The paper filters web samples by length but does not report a semantic contamination audit across the text, web, robot, teacher-output, and evaluation sources.

Repository and derived-dataset licenses do not establish rights for every upstream asset. Per-record origin, source versions, retained/rejected candidate IDs, immutable split files, raw rollout logs, seeds, dependency pins, environment images, and complete verifier edge behavior remain unknown or only partially disclosed.

精确完全匹配和精确条目 F1 可能惩罚语义等价的输出，并可能奖励格式或分词对齐。负 L1 加 LPIPS 衡量的是帧相似度，而不是物理正确性、因果保真度或用于策略部署时的安全性。这些反馈信号均不能替代下游任务验证。

文字游戏描述没有以足够细的阶段粒度说明 2,954 条官方测试子集的使用方式，因而无法审计训练/评测重叠。WebArena 流程按最高测试奖励选择检查点，因此没有记录独立的最终选择面。论文按长度过滤网页样本，但没有报告跨文字、网页、机器人、教师输出和评测来源的语义污染审计。

仓库和派生数据集的许可证并不能证明每一种上游资产的权利。逐记录来源、来源版本、保留/拒绝候选 ID、不可变切分文件、原始 rollout 日志、随机种子、依赖锁定、环境镜像以及完整验证器边界行为仍属未知或仅部分披露。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For post-training work, this Card is useful when choosing what an RLVR reward is allowed to claim. It provides three concrete, evidence-backed examples of transition feedback: symbolic state agreement, web-state change agreement, and perceptual future-frame agreement. A practitioner can use them to specify a verifier boundary before generalizing a result to planning, robotics, or agent deployment.

For data curation, the Card separates released derived language datasets and checkpoints from the named upstream transition sources. That separation helps reviewers ask for record-level lineage, source rights, immutable splits, and rejection logs instead of assuming that a model collection is a complete training-data release.

For evaluation, the reported WebArena and video procedures are starting points for replication design, not deployment certificates. Any downstream use should independently validate environment versions, semantic reward robustness, physical validity, and train/evaluation separation.

对于后训练工作，本 Card 适用于界定某个 RLVR 奖励可以声称什么。它提供了三个有证据支撑的状态转移反馈实例：符号状态一致性、网页状态变化一致性以及感知未来帧一致性。实践者可以在把结果推广到规划、机器人或智能体部署之前，先据此明确验证器边界。

对于数据整理，本 Card 将已发布的派生语言数据集和检查点与具名上游状态转移来源分开。这种区分帮助审查者要求逐记录血缘、来源权利、不可变切分和拒绝日志，而不是把模型集合默认视为完整训练数据发布。

对于评测，论文报告的 WebArena 和视频流程可以作为复现实验设计的起点，而不是部署证书。任何下游使用都应独立验证环境版本、语义奖励鲁棒性、物理有效性以及训练/评测隔离。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the data-object and reward sections together: a text or web state transition is not an end-to-end agent trajectory.
  • Check release scope separately from paper inputs: two derived language datasets and checkpoints are visible, while a unified upstream manifest is not.
  • Treat complete match, exact-item F1, and L1 plus LPIPS as task-specific feedback contracts rather than equivalent truth signals.
  • Before reuse, resolve the text-game subset role, WebArena checkpoint-selection surface, source rights, immutable splits, and environment/rollout provenance.

• 应将数据对象与奖励部分一并阅读：文字或网页状态转移并不是端到端智能体轨迹。
  • 应将发布范围与论文输入分开核查：可见的是两个派生语言数据集和检查点，而不是统一的上游清单。
  • 应把完全匹配、精确条目 F1 与 L1 加 LPIPS 视为任务特定的反馈契约，而不是可互换的真值信号。
  • 再利用前应厘清文字游戏子集角色、WebArena 检查点选择面、来源权利、不可变切分以及环境/rollout 血缘。

引用
html:

value.html: A heterogeneous set of world-transition inputs: ByteSized32 text-game transitions; WMA data collected from WebArena; RT-1 robot trajectories from Open X-Embodiment; and PushT, Rope, and Granular data supplied by DINO-WM. The THUML collection visibly releases derived text-game and WebArena CoT datasets; it does not provide a single source-level manifest for all upstream inputs.

Language tasks condition on natural-language rules/context, state and action and predict state differences or exact accessibility-tree changes; text-game targets include next state, rule reward and completion. Video tasks condition on visual observations plus quantized actions and predict one or multiple future frames.

Text-game SFT targets are correct DeepSeek-R1 responses retained by rejection sampling; WebArena SFT targets concatenate GPT-4o-mini CoT released by WMA with author-extracted changed items; video records are observed robot/simulated trajectories. RLVR response/frame candidates are sampled from the current policy.

Text games; WebArena web navigation on Docker-configured AWS EC2; RT-1 tabletop robot manipulation; and PushT/Rope/Granular environments. The released code implements sequence-modeling world models with GRPO RLVR.

Rule-based feedback against ground truth: text-game complete-match binary reward or property-aware task reward; WebArena exact-item F1 over changed accessibility-tree items; video negative L1 plus LPIPS on decoded predicted frames.

Text-game records include a completion flag. For web/video RLVR, reward evaluates a next-state or frame prediction against ground truth rather than a universally released episode-success predicate; full per-record terminal semantics outside text games are unknown.
Language: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 7B (the web run uses 1.5B). Video: separate 138M LLaMA-style autoregressive transformers trained from scratch with frozen visual tokenizers for RLVR.
DeepSeek-R1 for rejection-sampled text-game SFT; GPT-4o-mini CoT annotations released by WMA for the WebArena SFT target; no teacher is reported for video trajectories.
On-policy GRPO samples for language state-transition prediction and autoregressive visual-token samples for video prediction; offline SFT targets are constructed as stated in the data object.

Language GRPO uses group size 5, temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0. Text uses 4,237 rejection-sampled SFT examples. Web retains about 7,000 of 14,000 trajectories after length filtering, split 99%/1%. RT-1 uses 99%/1%; main video analysis uses GRPO group size 16.

Text: retain correct DeepSeek-R1 responses through rejection sampling; downsample unchanged transitions (changed:unchanged 100:40 for binary reward and 100:5 for task-specific reward). Web: remove prompt-plus-target pairs over 5,000 tokens; extract precise item changes from accessibility trees. Video: use named dataset splits and fixed trajectory segments; further filtering details are partially unknown.

Language RLVR maximum response length: 4,096 text-game and 7,288 WebArena tokens. Web MPC samples 20 candidate actions, keeps the three most frequent and repeats value scoring 20 times; video horizon is one frame or seven future frames depending on setting.
GRPO with a clipped objective and KL penalty. Language models receive LoRA SFT before RLVR; video uses VQGAN/FSQ visual tokenizers, autoregressive transformers and frozen tokenizers during RLVR.

The paper identifies ByteSized32, WMA/WebArena, RT-1/Open X-Embodiment and DINO-WM sources. It reports 76,369 ByteSized32 transitions from 31 games, about 7,000 retained WebArena trajectories, and 87,212 RT-1 trajectories. A record-level cross-source mixture, retained IDs and rejected-sample ledger are not released as one immutable manifest.

ByteSized32 has a 2,954-transition official high-quality test subset; the paper says it uses that subset for SFT and RLVR experiments but does not make the stage-specific allocation fully explicit. Web retains about 7,000 trajectories after length filtering and uses 99%/1% train/test. RT-1 uses 99%/1%; PushT/Rope/Granular use the source-provided splits. Exact immutable split files were not verified.

The paper filters WebArena samples by length and describes sampling/split choices, but does not report a semantic contamination or train-evaluation-overlap audit across text games, WebArena, robot trajectories, upstream teacher outputs, or downstream evaluation surfaces.

items: Exact complete-match or exact-item F1 rewards can penalize semantically equivalent predictions and can favor formatting or tokenization behavior.

The WebArena procedure selects the checkpoint with the highest test reward, so an independent final selection surface is not documented.
Video perceptual metrics (L1 and LPIPS) are not evidence that predicted trajectories are physically correct or safe for policy deployment.

value.html: The THUML repository is MIT; author-linked text-game and WebArena dataset cards state MIT; the paper says RT-1 follows Apache. Rights and licenses for upstream ByteSized32, WMA/WebArena, GPT-4o-mini-derived CoT, DINO-WM inputs and every underlying asset are otherwise unknown.

Named upstream transition sources -> teacher/rejection-sampled or extracted SFT targets -> LoRA/SFT -> on-policy GRPO RLVR -> author-linked data/model collection. Per-record origin, exact source version, rejected candidate and final-checkpoint lineage are incomplete.
